items.text: Jehova Nyasaye nowacho e kindeno niya, "Anabed Nyasach dhout Israel duto, kendo ginibed joga."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
"Jogo motony e ligangla noyud ngʼwono e piny motimo ongoro;
Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyorenwa chon, kawacho niya:
mi udhi oko ma umiel gi ilo.
Odiechiengʼ moro nobedie ma jorit noywagi
e gode matindo mag Efraim niya,
'Biuru wadhi Sayun, ir Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa.' "
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
kog matek ne jotelo madongo mag ogendini.
Onego pak magu owinjre, kendo uwachi niya,
'Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, res jogi, jo-Israel mane otony.'
Ne, anakelgi ka gia e piny
kendo achokgi ka gia e tungʼ
Dhano ma galamoro nodwogi motingʼo muofni
mine ma yach kod mamuoch kayo.
Anatelnegi e bath aore man-gi pi,
e kuonde mopie ma ok ginichwanyre,
kendo landeuru e kuonde maboyo manie dho nembe:
kendo enoresgi e lwet jogo matek moloyogi.
e kuonde motingʼore gi malo mag Sayun;
ginibed gi ilo kuom chiwo mabup mar Jehova Nyasaye,
ma gin cham, divai manyien kod mo,
Ginichal gi puodho moole pi maber,
kendo ok ginibed gi kuyo kendo.
yawuowi matindo kod joma oti machalre.
anahogi kendo anamigi ilo kar kuyo.
gi chiwo mara mabup," Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
Rael ywago nyithinde kendo odagi ni ok nyal hoye,
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
"Lingʼ iwe ywak kendo ywe pi wangʼi,
Giniduogi ka gia e piny wasigu." Jehova Nyasaye wacho.
Ne imiya kum ka nyaroya ma lelo,
Bangʼ kane asebaro, ne akwayo weruok;
bangʼ kane wach osedonjona, ne agoyo agoga.
Wiya nokuot kendo ne awinjo lit,
nikech ne atingʼo wichkuot mar bedona rawera.
Kata obedo ni awuoyoga kuome marach,
to pod apare. Emomiyo chunya ywage,"
an-gi kech kuome, Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
Duogi, yaye Israel ma nyako ngili, duogi e dalau.
Jehova Nyasaye enochwe gima nyien e piny,

Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: "Kagologi gia e twech, joma ni e piny Juda kod dalagi noti gi wechegi kendo ni: 'Jehova Nyasaye ogwedhu, yaye kar dak maler, yaye got mowal.'
Ji nodag kaachiel e kanyakla ei Juda kod miechgi duto, jopur kod jogo mawuotho ka gi kacha gi jambgi.
Anami joma ool teko kendo joma chunygi onyosore anajiw."
Kuom mani ne achiewo kendo ne angʼiyo alworana. To nindo mara nobedona mamit.
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, "Ndalo biro ma anapidhe od Israel kod od Juda gi koth ji kod mar le.
Mana kaka ne angʼiyogi mondo apudhgi kendo kethogi, mondo awitgi oko ka atiekogi kendo kelonegi chandruok, anaritgi mondo agergi kendo pidhogi," Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
"E ndalono ji ok nochak owach kendo niya,
Makmana, ngʼato ka ngʼato notho nikech richone owuon; ngʼato angʼata mochano olemo ma wach-wach, lake owuon ema notho."
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, "Kinde biro ma anatim
singruok manyien gi dhood jo-Israel kod dhood jo-Juda.
mi atelonegi kagologi e piny Misri,
gi dhood jo-Israel bangʼ ndalogo," Jehova Nyasaye owacho.
Koro ngʼato ok nochak opuonj jabathe,
kochakore ngʼat matinie moloyo nyaka ngʼat maduongʼie moloyo,"
kendo ok anachak apar richogi kendo."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho,
ruto, Jehova Nyasaye Maratego e nyinge:
e kaka nyikwa Israel nowe bedo oganda e nyima."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho:
kendo mise mar piny inyalo many,
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, "Kinde biro, ma dala maduongʼ ibiro gerona kendo, kochakore Kar Ngʼicho Motingʼore gi Malo mar Hananel nyaka e Dhoranga Kona.
Tond pimo norie kochakore kanyo tir nyaka e got matin mar Gareb bangʼe ogomo kochiko Goa.

Holono duto mopongʼ gi ringre joma otho kendo kama ipuke buru, kod kuonde duto mokuny duto, nodhi e Holo mar Kidron man yo wuok chiengʼ mochopo nyaka e kona ma Dhoranga Faras, nobed maler ne Jehova Nyasaye. Dala maduongʼni ok nomuki kata kethi."
